title: SourceRegion
description: Exact occurrence and evidence locator within one immutable extraction revision.

extraction_run_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized SourceExtractionRun in the owning institution.

ordinal.description: Stable region order within accepted page receipt.

bbox_mpt.description: Upright cropped page rectangle x0, y0, x1, y1 in integer milli-points.

review_state.description: Region decision pinned in the extraction revision.

confidence_permille.description: Optional OCR engine signal, not a correctness guarantee.

evidence_object_id.description: Protected page evidence shard with raw and normalized representations.
evidence_object_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution. Platform purpose evidence and exact owner SourceExtractionRun. Resolve actual object version and digest before use.

evidence_path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into exact evidence shard.

payload_digest.description: Canonical accepted region content and geometry digest.

sensitivity.description: Minimum protected retrieval and crop restriction.

x-invariants: Rectangle positive area and fully inside reviewed upright page extent.
Review never discloses protected region bytes through metadata or event payload.
Regions are referenced only when accepted by a sealed extraction.

If a page shard contains a restricted region, full shard retrieval requires the strongest applicable authority. A weaker scope receives only an independently approved redacted rendition, never its underlying object ID.
